metadata.name: Viberion
metadata.description: A first-person open-world RPG in Three.js on a 1km procedural island. Start in wilderness, follow the road to the Nordic village of Kaldmere. Rayleigh/Mie atmosphere with volumetric light shafts, day/night cycle, 430k-blade wind grass, layered undergrowth, hand-rolled post chain (bloom, DOF, ACES, colour grade), 13-structure village, 11 creature types, skill-and-perk combat, branching dialogue, quests, and a cloth map. Full touch controls on iPad. Every texture, mesh and sound generated at runtime.
